content: Root cause: The bug was caused by insufficient checking of whether the high-level `statfs_x` callback was implemented by the actual file system when using modules. The previous implementation only checked if `f->op.statfs_x` existed, which was not adequate in scenarios where file systems were loaded as modules. This led to incorrect behavior when attempting to use the `statfs_x` functionality, resulting in potential crashes or incorrect file system statistics being returned. The fix introduced a dedicated flag (`statfs_x_ok`) to accurately track the availability of the `statfs_x` callback, ensuring that the code correctly handles cases where the callback is not implemented.
